description: holon-coherence accumulates pending ledger fragments under holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/ with no .github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml workflow, risking stale unpromoted ledgers or silent no-ops when the promotion bot secret is unconfigured.
goal: Add .github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml (using ./.github/actions/ci-timing-gate and zero YAML comments) triggered on push to main filtered by paths ['holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/**'], daily cron schedule, and workflow_dispatch with a boolean force input, skipping commits containing '[ledger-promote]'. When secrets.HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN is unset or empty, count pending *.jsonl files under holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/ and emit an explicit ::warning:: (when pending files > 0) or ::notice:: (when 0) with the backlog count in GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY instead of a silent green no-op. When configured, run an inline Python promotion step (no new files under scripts/) appending each pending fragment's JSONL rows into canonical holon-knowledge/ledger/{intents,plans,executions}.jsonl while keeping existing canonical rows byte-identical and deduplicating existing lines, delete promoted pending files, enforce that only holon-knowledge/ledger/ paths changed, and commit/push with '[ledger-promote]'. Add unit tests in tests/test_promote_ledger_workflow.py verifying triggers, missing-token warning vs notice, and promotion logic on a temporary git repository. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python and YAML files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Debounced pending-ledger promotion keeps canonical ledgers current without per-push cancel storms and alerts visibly when pending fragments pile up without a bot secret.
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml triggers on push to main with paths 'holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/**', schedule, and workflow_dispatch, checks secrets.HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN, and has zero YAML comments.
When HOLON_LEDGER_BOT_TOKEN is empty and pending fragments exist under holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/, the missing-token step emits '::warning::' with the pending count rather than staying silent.

tests/test_promote_ledger_workflow.py parses .github/workflows/promote-ledger.yml, tests missing-token warning and promotion behavior on temporary repositories, and passes with zero docstrings or comments under 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint'.
holon-coherence has an automated ledger-promotion workflow (or explicit non-silent backlog alert when bot token is absent) and holon-knowledge/ledger/pending/ is drained cleanly.
